en: The postcard shows a historical black-and-white photograph of steam-powered ships breaking through ice on a frozen body of water. The largest visible ship has the name 'KOLBJØRN' painted on its side, and dark smoke is billowing from its funnel. Several people are walking on the ice near the ships, contributing to the sense of scale and harsh winter conditions. There is a handwritten signature or caption at the bottom right.
